recipes.editInstruction: Remove all ground: erase the green grass and brown soil block under the fish so the three fish float directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under them. Keep the three fish, their golden-yellow bodies and dark blue backs, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
recipes.notes: fish-shoal-a drew a good tight shoal of three, but lying on a grass and soil block.

recipes.editInstruction: Remove the round pond, its green grass rim and its brown soil base: keep only the two leaping fish and the small white water splash under them, on a transparent background with nothing else. Keep the fish, outline and art style exactly the same.
recipes.notes: fish-pair-a drew the two leaping fish over a round pond island; keep the fish and the splash, drop the pond.
